The issue was caused by R8 / ProGuard code shrinking stripping generic type signatures in minified release builds. Gson's `TypeToken` relies on generic signatures preserved in the bytecode (`getClass().getGenericSuperclass()`) to extract type arguments at runtime.

To fix this, the required R8 / ProGuard rules were added to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r2/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):

- `-keepattributes Signature`: Preserves generic signatures across classes and members.
- `-keepattributes *Annotation*,EnclosingMethod,InnerClasses`: Keeps necessary metadata for reflection and anonymous inner classes.
- `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` and `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }`: Preserves `TypeToken` and any anonymous subclasses (such as `object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}`).
- `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`: Preserves model classes and fields so Gson can deserialize JSON keys without field name obfuscation.
